insights.one_liner: Ava Global Logistics is a small UK-based specialist in secure transport of cash and precious metals, with a finance manager role in Amsterdam; not a recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: Ava moves and stores cash, bullion and precious metals for banks, central banks, mines, refineries and traders, with a personal, concierge-style approach.
It is a small team of about 56 people on LinkedIn, headquartered in Royal Tunbridge Wells, UK.
Staff mostly studied business, economics or political science, at schools like the University of Essex and University of Buenos Aires.

open.text: Ava Global Logistics is not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
